title: Key Reasons to Add Digital Realty Stock to Your Portfolio Now
author: Na
description: Digital Realty (DLR) signed $307 million in Q2 bookings with a record $1.9 billion backlog, driven by AI and cloud demand. The company is expanding capacity through land purchases and data-center acquisitions, with 1.4 GW under construction at 11.5% yield. Strong balance sheet and diverse tenant base support long-term growth prospects.

title: Equinix & CPP Investments Complete $4 Billion atNorth Acquisition
author: Na
description: Equinix and Canada Pension Plan Investment Board have completed their $4 billion acquisition of Nordic data center operator atNorth. CPP Investments owns 51% while Equinix holds 34% of the company. The deal is immediately accretive to Equinix's AFFO per share and expands their exposure to AI-ready Nordic infrastructure with eight operational data centers across the Nordic region.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The acquisition is immediately accretive to AFFO per share, provides meaningful geographic diversification, supports AI and hyperscale growth strategy, and aligns with long-term growth outlook of 9-12% annual AFFO-per-share growth through 2029.

title: Equinix, NVIDIA & Together AI Accelerate Enterprise AI Inference
author: Na
description: Equinix has partnered with NVIDIA and Together AI to launch Equinix Inference Exchange, a distributed AI inference platform for enterprises. The solution combines NVIDIA's Enterprise Reference Architectures, Together AI's inference capabilities, and Equinix's global infrastructure to enable faster, more cost-efficient AI deployment across multiple geographies. The platform will support metro-edge inference, open-source models, and sovereign AI requirements, with availability expected in Q1 2027.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Equinix is strengthening its positioning in enterprise AI through a strategic partnership that leverages its global infrastructure of 280+ data centers. The initiative aligns with rising AI demand and provides a new growth opportunity as enterprises move AI workloads to production, with the company gaining 4.8% in the past six months.

NVIDIA is expanding its collaboration with Equinix by providing Enterprise Reference Architectures and AI infrastructure designed to optimize AI factory throughput and minimize token costs, reinforcing its role in the enterprise AI ecosystem.

title: 4 Reasons Why OUTFRONT Stock Is a Solid Portfolio Pick Now
author: Na
description: OUTFRONT Media (OUT) demonstrates solid fundamentals with digital revenues rising 23.3% to $193.7 million and transit revenues climbing 32.3% to $140.6 million, led by a 48% increase at New York MTA. The company's diversified U.S. footprint across 120 markets, digital billboard conversions generating 4-5x higher revenues, and permit-based competitive barriers support long-term growth. Analysts maintain a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating with favorable estimate revisions for 2026 AFFO per share.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong revenue growth across digital (23.3%) and transit (32.3%) segments, diversified geographic footprint reducing concentration risk, high barriers to entry through permits, and positive analyst revisions support bullish outlook. Stock outperformed industry peers over past six months.

title: United States Data Center Colocation Market Outlook & Forecast 2026-2031 | Renewable Energy Gains Ground Across U.S. Colocation Facilities
author: Researchandmarkets.Com
description: The U.S. data center colocation market is projected to grow from $43.71 billion in 2025 to $85.18 billion by 2031 at an 11.76% CAGR, driven by AI adoption, cloud computing, hyperscale expansion, and renewable energy initiatives. The Southeastern U.S. leads investment with over $15 billion in 2025, followed by the Southwest. Major operators are deploying liquid-cooling technologies and high-density infrastructure to support GPU-intensive AI workloads.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Reported that renewable sources supplied 75% of global electricity requirements with 1.5 GW of contracted renewable capacity, matched 185 data centers with 100% renewable energy, and achieved ENERGY STAR certification across 69% of U.S. portfolio.
